knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

## Objective
The objective of this is to explore a range of candidate lymphocyte features 
to select for project inclusion


- **lymphocyte cellularity**
  - *lymphocytes_median_log_closest_neighbor_um* (left skewed - log transformation and median iqr)
  - *lymphocyte_count_per_1000_um2*
  - *epithelium_lamina_propria_ratio*
  
- **patchy infiltration / clustering**
  - *lymphocytes_cluster_median_closest_neighbor_um*
  - *lymphocytes_cluster_count_per_1000_um2*
  - *lymphocytes_cluster_iqr_log_closest_neighbor_um*
  - *lymphocytes_cluster_median_cluster_n_lymphocytes*
  - *lymphocytes_cluster_iqr_log_cluster_n_lymphocytes *
  - *lymphocytes_cluster_iqr_log_closest_junction_um*
  - *lymphocytes_iqr_log_closest_neighbor_um * (left skewed - log transformation and median iqr) - low - clusters?

- **junctional_gradient**
  -*median_log_closest_junction_um*(left skewed - log transformation makes it right skewed)
  -*lymphocytes_cluster_median_log_closest_junction_um*
 
- **size**
  -*mean_measured_area_um2 *
- **heterogeneity**
  -*sd_measured_area_um2 *

   


```{r}
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)



lymphocyte_features <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/lymphocyte_distribution_features/feature_summaries/lymphocyte_feature_summaries_labl_2020_tuning_included_fragments.json")

lymphocyte_features_image_names <- lymphocyte_features$image_name

subset <- fromJSON("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_images/output/process_subset/subset_labl_2020_tuning.json") %>% 
  filter(image_name %in% lymphocyte_features_image_names) 

file_paths <- subset$file_path

writeLines(file_paths, "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/explore_lymphocyte_distribution/file_paths.txt")
```





## Explore villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_median_log_closest_neighbor_um as a measure of cellularity in villus epithelum

```{r}
villi_epithelum_lc_median_log_closest_neighbor <- lymphocyte_features %>%
  select(image_name:mucosa_name, villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_median_log_closest_neighbor_um)


distance_var <- "villi_epithelium_lymphocytes_median_log_closest_neighbor_um"


median_val <- median(lymphocyte_features[[distance_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
q1 <- quantile(lymphocyte_features[[distance_var]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
q3 <- quantile(lymphocyte_features[[distance_var]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
iqr <- q3 - q1

# Create the plot
ggplot(lymphocyte_features, aes(x = .data[[distance_var]])) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 30, fill = "grey80", color = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_density(color = "blue", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median_val, color = "red", linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = q1, color = "darkgreen", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = q3, color = "darkgreen", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Distribution of", distance_var),
    x = paste(distance_var, "(µm)"),
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9, base_family = "Arial") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    label = paste0("Median = ", round(median_val, 2), "\nIQR = ", round(iqr, 2)),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.1,
    size = 3, family = "Arial"
  )




```
